meta.claim_boundary: Proves the return shape and flag equivalence on Maya 2024 on this box only. The probe read |persp, an unparented transform, so the world-space flag cannot be distinguished from local space here; a parented transform is not verified. Maya 2025/2026 is not installed on this host. The driver issues only query calls (about, ls, listRelatives, xform with query=True, getAttr, file query, currentUnit query). It recorded node count 8 before and after, currentUnit cm before and after, and modified=False before and after, so the run created or removed nothing and changed no scene setting.
